name: שברים חלקיים – (ax² + b)/(x·(x+c)²) (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Express

\[ {{CT:0}} \]

as a sum of partial fractions.

[[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: The denominator has the linear factor \(x\) and the repeated linear factor; we write the partial-fraction form, multiply out and match coefficients.
Step 1 — The form
Below are the rules of partial fractions.
Rules of partial fractions. If the degree of the numerator is at least the degree of the denominator, divide first. Then each factor of the denominator gives terms:
  • a linear factor \(ax+b\): \(\dfrac{A}{ax+b}\);
  • a repeated linear factor \((ax+b)^2\): \(\dfrac{A}{ax+b}+\dfrac{B}{(ax+b)^2}\);
  • an irreducible quadratic factor \(ax^2+bx+c\): \(\dfrac{Ax+B}{ax^2+bx+c}\).
As a sum of partial fractions

\[ {{CT:0}}=\frac{A}{x}+\frac{B}{{CT:1}}+\frac{C}{{CT:2}}, \]

Step 2 — Multiplying out
and multiplying both sides through by {{CT:3}} we find

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle {{CT:4}}&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:5}} + {{CT:6}} + {{CT:7}},\\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:8}} + {{CT:9}} + {{CT:10}} + {{CT:11}} + {{CT:12}} + {{CT:7}},\\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:13}} + {{CT:14}} + {{CT:10}}. \end{array} \]

Step 3 — Matching coefficients
Matching coefficients

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle A + B&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:15}}\,\\ {{CT:16}} + C&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle 0,\\ {{CT:17}}&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:18}}. \end{array} \]

So,

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle A&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:19}},\\ B&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:15}} - A = {{CT:15}} - {{CT:19}},\\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:20}},\\ C&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:21}} = {{CT:22}} - {{CT:23}},\\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:24}}. \end{array} \]

Step 4 — The answer
Therefore,

\[ {{CT:0}}={{CT:25}}. \]
